enchantment.spectral_enchantments.broad_: Allows the tool to break blocks in a wider area. Sneak to break a single block.
enchantment.spectral_enchantments.spectr: Summons the enchanted weapon to fight by your side. Must be in your hotbar or offhand.
enchantment.spectral_enchantments.far_mi: Look at a block beyond your reach for a moment to summon a spectral copy of the tool there, then hold attack to mine it from afar.
enchantment.spectral_enchantments.gather: Items dropped by blocks you break or creatures you slay go straight into your inventory when there is room.
enchantment.spectral_enchantments.branch: Use on leaves to outline, for a short while, every log hidden inside the canopy. Costs durability.
enchantment.spectral_enchantments.animat: Give the weapon to an armor stand and it flies out to fight hostile mobs nearby. Or sneak and use it on the ground to leave it fighting there for a while.
